title: Sindhu's World Championships Run Ends, Doubles Pairs Advance to Quarters
indian_angle: PV Sindhu's singles campaign at the World Championships concluded, but India's hopes remain high with Treesa-Gayatri and Satwik-Chirag progressing in doubles.
summary: PV Sindhu's journey at the BWF World Championships ended after a tough match, while India's women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, along with men's doubles duo Satwik-Chirag, successfully advanced to the quarter-finals.

title: Treesa Jolly, Gayatri Gopichand Stun 7th Seeds to Reach World Championships Quarters
indian_angle: The unseeded Indian women's doubles pair achieved a remarkable upset, defeating a highly-ranked Japanese duo to secure their spot in the World Championships quarter-finals.
summary: India's 39th-ranked women's doubles pair, Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, delivered a stunning performance at the World Badminton Championships, overcoming a 7th-seeded Japanese pair to advance to the quarter-finals.

title: India Open Retains Winter Slot Amidst Player Workload and Pollution Concerns
indian_angle: The decision to keep the India Open in its winter window impacts Indian players and fans, raising questions about player health and logistical challenges due to Delhi's air quality.
summary: The BWF has confirmed the India Open will remain in its winter slot despite criticism regarding player workload and pollution concerns, with Secretary General Thomas Lund urging understanding for scheduling complexities.

title: Lakshya Sen Suffers Shock Early Exit at World Championships
indian_angle: India's promising men's singles player Lakshya Sen unexpectedly exited the World Championships in the second round, a setback for the Indian contingent.
summary: Indian shuttler Lakshya Sen faced a surprising second-round defeat against USA's Garret Tan at the BWF World Championships, marking an early end to his campaign, while PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty secured wins.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's next generation of badminton stars for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: The Indian junior badminton team is currently undergoing a coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, in preparation for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: India-Born Ishika Jaiswal Impresses on World Stage, Shows Resilience
indian_angle: India-born Ishika Jaiswal's journey and performance at the BWF World Championships highlight the global reach of Indian talent in badminton and her potential for future success.
summary: India-born shuttler Ishika Jaiswal showcased resilience and ambition during her tough BWF World Championships match against Nozomi Okuhara, impressing on the world stage as she charts her unique path in the sport.
